meta_description:
98 likes, 7 comments - cnet on October 29, 2026: "Add to cart? DoorDash, the largest food delivery service in the US, is planning to acquire grocery delivery service Instacart in a massive $17 billion deal, DoorDash announced on Thursday.

According to DoorDash, once the deal is complete, both delivery services will continue to operate on separate platforms, and the Instacart name will remain. If you’re a DashPass and Instacart Plus subscriber, you will only have to pay one membership fee for perks from both platforms.

Should the deal move forward, it’s not expected to close before late 2027.

Read more at CNET.com #doordash #instacart #delivery #grocery #acquisition".
